title: Presidential UFO briefings, Nixon to Bush, but not Clinton
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Presidential UFO briefings, Nixon to Bush, but not Clinton, about 1969-1993 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Nixon, Carter, Reagan, Bush all seem to have received briefings. The moment you get to Clinton, I think it's pretty demonstrable he didn't.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that US presidents from 1969 to 1993, Nixon, Carter, Reagan and the first Bush, all seem to have been given private briefings about UFOs. He says it is pretty clear that Bill Clinton, who came next, was not, which if true would mean the briefings stopped at some point and presidents were left outside.
